outlooks.summary: SCATTERED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL CONTINUE THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING ACROSS PARTS OF THE NORTHERN ROCKIES AND NORTHERN PLAINS. LARGE TO VERY LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND ARE THE PRIMARY THREATS...BUT A TORNADO OR TWO IS ALSO POSSIBLE...ESPECIALLY OVER CENTRAL MONTANA. OTHER STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS ARE POSSIBLE ACROSS A PORTION OF THE SOUTHERN AND CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS...AS WELL AS A PORTION OF THE UPPER MIDWEST. A FEW DOWNBURST WINDS AND LARGE HAIL ARE THE PRIMARY THREATS IN THESE AREAS.

sections.title: DISCUSSION
sections.text: THE ONLY SUBSTANTIAL CHANGE THIS OUTLOOK WAS TO INCREASE HAIL PROBABILITIES ACROSS CNTRL INTO NERN MT. STEEP LOW TO MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND VERY STRONG EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES /55-60 KT/ ARE GOING TO SUPPORT UPDRAFT ROTATION/SUPERCELLS WITH THE STRONGER STORMS THIS AFTERNOON INTO EARLY EVENING ACROSS CNTRL MT. RECENT ITERATIONS OF THE OPERATIONAL HRRR AND ESRL HRRR SHOW THIS ACTIVITY QUICKLY MOVING ENEWD INTO NERN MT LATER THIS AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING. GIVEN THE FAVORABLE SHEAR/LAPSE RATES AND SUFFICIENT MOISTURE SETUP...IT SEEMS PRUDENT TO BOTH PROBABILISTICALLY AND CATEGORICALLY UPGRADE A SMALL CORRIDOR NEAR AND DOWNSTREAM OF THE DEVELOPING STRONGER STORMS/SUPERCELLS. ..SMITH.. 06/09/2016 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1131 AM CDT THU JUN 09 2016/

sections.title: NRN ROCKIES THROUGH NRN PLAINS AREA
sections.text: EARLY THIS MORNING A WEAK QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT EXTENDS FROM NERN THROUGH SWRN MT. FARTHER NORTH A SECONDARY BOUNDARY STRETCHES FROM SASKATCHEWAN SWWD INTO NWRN MT...AND THIS FEATURE WILL BEGIN TO SHIFT SEWD FARTHER INTO MT AS UPSTREAM WINDS VEER IN RESPONSE TO A SHORTWAVE TROUGH EJECTING NEWD THROUGH SRN ALBERTA. SFC DATA SHOW DEWPOINTS IN THE MID TO UPPER 50S ACROSS MUCH OF MT INTO THE WRN DAKOTAS...BUT ONSET OF DEEP MIXING SHOULD RESULT IN BOUNDARY-LAYER DEWPOINTS MIXING DOWN INTO THE UPPER 40S TO LOW 50S THIS AFTERNOON. WITH STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES IN PLACE...MLCAPE SHOULD INCREASE TO 1000-1500 J/KG IN THIS REGION. CURRENT INDICATIONS /INCLUDING GOOD AGREEMENT AMONG SEVERAL CAMS/ ARE THAT STORMS WILL INITIATE OVER THE MOUNTAINS OF WRN MT DURING THE EARLY AFTERNOON AND SPREAD EWD THROUGH CNTRL AND NERN MT AND NWRN ND INTO THE EARLY EVENING. OTHER STORMS MAY FORM ALONG LEE TROUGH AXIS OVER ERN MT AND MOVE INTO WRN ND. STORMS WILL IN GENERAL BE HIGH BASED. HOWEVER...LOWER TEMPERATURE-DEWPOINTS SPREADS WILL EXIST ALONG THE SW-NE ORIENTED BOUNDARY ACROSS CNTRL MT. BELT OF STRONGER WINDS ALOFT WILL SUPPORT 45-50 KT EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR SUPPORTIVE OF SUPERCELLS FROM WRN THROUGH N

sections.title: CENTRAL/SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: IN THE WAKE OF A WEAK EARLY-DAY MCV ACROSS KS AND SOME RELATED CLOUD COVER/LIGHT PRECIPITATION...THE AIR MASS SHOULD BECOME MODERATELY UNSTABLE WITHIN A MODESTLY MOIST /GENERALLY 50S F SURFACE DEWPOINTS/AIRMASS NEAR AND EAST OF A SURFACE TROUGH/DRYLINE. AT LEAST WIDELY SCATTERED STRONG THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT SHOULD OCCUR LATER THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING ESPECIALLY ACROSS SOUTHEAST CO/EASTERN NM INTO WESTERN KS AND THE OK/TX PANHANDLES. WHILE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR WILL BE WEAK /20-25 KT EFFECTIVE OR LESS/...STEEP LAPSE RATES AND MODERATELY LARGE CAPE WILL ALLOW FOR MULTICELLS POTENTIALLY CAPABLE OF SEVERE HAIL/WIND FROM MID-AFTERNOON INTO THIS EVENING.

sections.title: UPPER MIDWEST AREA
sections.text: STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO REDEVELOP/INTENSITY THIS EVENING AS THE ATMOSPHERE DESTABILIZES IN VICINITY OF CONVECTIVELY REINFORCED BOUNDARY. REDEVELOPMENT WILL BE IN RESPONSE TO STRENGTHENING LLJ INTERACTING WITH THE BOUNDARY. A FEW STORMS MAY PRODUCE STRONG WIND GUSTS HAIL.

outlooks.summary: SCATTERED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL CONTINUE THIS EVENING ACROSS PARTS OF THE NORTHERN ROCKIES AND NORTHERN PLAINS. LARGE TO VERY LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND ARE THE PRIMARY THREATS...BUT A TORNADO OR TWO IS ALSO POSSIBLE. OTHER STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS ARE POSSIBLE ACROSS A PORTION OF THE SOUTHERN AND CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS...AS WELL AS A PORTION OF THE UPPER MIDWEST. A FEW DOWNBURST WINDS AND LARGE HAIL ARE THE PRIMARY THREATS IN THESE AREAS.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A FRONTAL BOUNDARY EXTENDED FROM NORTHWEST NORTH DAKOTA THROUGH SOUTHERN MONTANA AT 01Z...WHILE A NEARLY STATIONARY FRONTAL BOUNDARY EXTENDED SOUTHEAST FROM EASTERN NORTH DAKOTA INTO CENTRAL ILLINOIS. A BELT OF STRONGER FLOW ALOFT WAS IN PLACE OVER THE NORTHERN ROCKIES DOWNSTREAM OF AN UPPER LOW JUST OFF THE PACIFIC NORTHWEST COAST. WEAK MID-LEVEL RIDGING WAS POSITIONED OVER THE NORTHERN PLAINS...WITH MODEST NORTHWEST FLOW ALOFT OVER THE UPPER MIDWEST.

sections.title: MT EWD TO THE DAKOTAS
sections.text: SCATTERED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WITH A HISTORY OF LARGE/ISOLATED VERY LARGE HAIL WERE IN PROGRESS AT 01Z ACROSS CENTRAL/EASTERN MONTANA...WITHIN AN UPSLOPE LOW-LEVEL FLOW REGIME NORTH OF THE AFOREMENTIONED SURFACE FRONTAL BOUNDARY. GIVEN RECENT RADAR TRENDS/REPORTS HAVE OPTED TO KEEP A SMALL ENHANCED RISK FOR LARGE HAIL ACROSS EAST-CENTRAL MONTANA...MAINLY FOR THE NEXT FEW HOURS. WITH TIME...STORMS SHOULD TEND TO EVOLVE INTO MORE OF A LINEAR STRUCTURE AND MOVE INTO WESTERN NORTH DAKOTA/NORTHWEST SOUTH DAKOTA WITH A SEVERE WIND AND HAIL RISK. HAVE EXPANDED THE SLIGHT RISK EASTWARD OVER SOUTHWEST NORTH DAKOTA TO ACCOUNT FOR THIS SCENARIO. INCREASING NOCTURNAL COOLING WITH TIME SHOULD RESULT IN A GRADUALLY DIMINISHING SEVERE THREAT AFTER ABOUT 06Z.

sections.title: UPPER MIDWEST
sections.text: REFERENCE MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 857 FOR LATEST SHORT-TERM THINKING REGARDING THE SEVERE THREAT ACROSS THE UPPER MIDWEST

sections.title: PORTIONS OF THE CENTRAL/SRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: REFERENCE MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 856 FOR LATEST CONVECTIVE TRENDS ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE CENTRAL/SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS. ..BUNTING.. 06/10/2016

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE POTENTIAL FOR SUPERCELL TSTMS WITH SIGNIFICANTLY SEVERE HAIL...SVR WIND GUSTS...AND PERHAPS A COUPLE OF TORNADOES IS INCREASING. SVR TSTMS WILL LIKELY BE ONGOING BY AROUND 20Z-21Z...AND A WW WILL LIKELY BE ISSUED WITHIN THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE LOOPS INDICATE RELATIVELY EARLY DEVELOPMENT OF DIURNAL...TERRAIN-ENHANCED CUMULUS FIELDS OVER THE WRN/CNTRL MT MOUNTAINS...FROM THE BITTERROOT RANGE TO THE SWRN MT MOUNTAINS TO THE LITTLE AND BIG BELT MOUNTAINS. THIS IS LIKELY A MANIFESTATION OF THE STRENGTHENING LARGE-SCALE ASCENT ACCOMPANYING A MID-LEVEL SPEED MAX PRESENTLY ORBITING THE SERN SEMI-CIRCLE OF A CYCLONE CENTERED OFF THE PACIFIC COAST. WATER VAPOR LOOPS SUGGEST THAT THE SPEED MAX IS ALREADY SPREADING ACROSS WRN MT. GIVEN THE ASSOCIATED ENHANCED LARGE-SCALE ASCENT...DIURNAL CONVECTIVE INITIATION OVER THE MOUNTAINS WILL LIKELY OCCUR EARLIER TODAY THAN TYPICAL OF PATTERNS LACKING LARGE-SCALE ASCENT. BY 19Z-20Z...TSTMS WILL LIKELY BECOME WIDELY SCATTERED FROM THE HELENA/BUTTE REGION TOWARD THE LEWISTOWN AREA...AND THEN SPREAD ENEWD INVOF AND IMMEDIATELY ON THE COOL SIDE OF A QUASI-STATIONARY BOUNDARY ANALYZED FROM BETWEEN JORDAN AND GLENDIVE...TO S OF LEWISTOWN...TO NEAR BUTTE. THE AIR MASS NEAR/N OF THE BOUNDARY CONTINUES TO DESTABILIZE OWING TO THE LACK OF ANY SUBSTANTIAL INFLUXES OF CONTINENTAL AIR SUBJECTED TO DOWNSLOPE WARMING/DRYING. SUCH FLUXES WILL PRINCIPALLY AFFECT THE GREAT FALLS TO CUT BANK TO HAVRE AREA AMIDST SWLY FLOW ALOFT...LEAVING A 90-120-MILE-WIDE CORRIDOR CENTERED ON HELENA TO LEWISTOWN TO E OF JORDAN WITH MLCAPE AROUND 750-1500 J/KG. THIS WILL BE AIDED BY STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES OVERLYING ADEQUATE LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE -- E.G. DEWPOINTS REMAIN IN THE 50S ACROSS PORTIONS OF CNTRL MT ON THE COOL SIDE OF THE BOUNDARY. AS 50-65 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OVERLAPS WITH THE DESTABILIZING AIR MASS...TSTMS THAT DEVELOP WILL LIKELY BECOME SUPERCELLULAR QUICKLY. FORECAST WIND PROFILES SUPPORT LONG/CURVED HODOGRAPHS THROUGH MUCH OF THE CONVECTIVE LAYER...WITH EFFECTIVE SRH AROUND

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A CATEGORICAL UPGRADE TO ENHANCED RISK FOR SVR HAIL IS PLANNED FOR THE 20Z DAY 1 OUTLOOK.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: INCREASING COVERAGE OF SUPERCELLS WITH SVR HAIL...SOME SIGNIFICANT...WARRANTS OUTLOOK UPGRADE TO ENH FOR THE 20Z DAY 1 OUTLOOK. ADDITIONAL DETAILS ARE FORTHCOMING IN OUTLOOK.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A RISK FOR ISOLATED SVR TSTMS WITH WIND/HAIL WILL EXIST WITH CONVECTION SPREADING ACROSS PORTIONS OF WYOMING INTO THE EVENING HOURS. WW ISSUANCE IS UNLIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: DIURNALLY ENHANCED OROGRAPHIC CIRCULATIONS CONTINUE TO FOSTER CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON...AIDED BY THE GLANCING INFLUENCE OF A MID-LEVEL SPEED MAX. VISIBLE SATELLITE LOOPS AND RADAR IMAGERY INDICATE THE MOST VIGOROUS CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT ACROSS THE ABSAROKA RANGE AND WIND RIVER RANGE...AND CONVECTION WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP/INTENSIFY DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS AND SPREAD NEWD/EWD. DEEP SHEAR IS RELATIVELY WEAKER COMPARED TO LOCATIONS FARTHER N/NW...AND THE BOUNDARY LAYER IS DRIER COMPARED TO LOCATIONS FARTHER N/NW. REGARDLESS...STEEP LAPSE RATES SUPPORTING MARGINAL TO MODERATE BUOYANCY AND 20-35 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR WILL SUPPORT A FEW INTENSE CONVECTIVE CORES WITH SVR HAIL. DEEPLY MIXED BOUNDARY LAYERS WILL ENCOURAGE EVAPORATIVE COOLING/ACCELERATION OF DOWNDRAFTS WITH STRONG OUTFLOW WINDS -- PERHAPS LOCALLY REACHING SVR LEVELS. WITHOUT STRONGER DEEP ASCENT / STRONGER DEEP SHEAR...AND WITHOUT GREATER BUOYANCY...THE SVR RISK IS FORECAST TO REMAIN ISOLATED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A THREAT FOR STRONG WIND GUSTS AND HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE LATE THIS AFTERNOON INTO EARLY EVENING ACROSS PARTS OF THE SRN HIGH PLAINS. THE POTENTIAL FOR SEVERE STORMS IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN TOO MARGINAL FOR WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A TROUGH OVER ERN NM WITH SOUTH TO SSELY FLOW TO THE EAST OF THE SFC TROUGH AND INCREASING LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE WITH EWD EXTENT. ACCORDING TO RAP ANALYSIS...MODERATE INSTABILITY IS NOW LOCATED FROM NEAR THE NM-TX STATE-LINE EWD ACROSS THE TX PANHANDLE AND REMAINDER OF WEST TX. THUNDERSTORMS ARE DEVELOPING ALONG THE SFC TROUGH NEAR THE AXIS OF A MID-LEVEL SHORTWAVE OVER THE SRN ROCKIES EVIDENT ON WATER VAPOR IMAGERY. AS THIS FEATURE CONTINUES TO MOVE SLOWLY SEWD...LARGE-SCALE ASCENT AND SOME ENHANCEMENT IN THE MID-LEVEL FLOW WILL SUPPORT THE DEVELOPMENT OF MARGINALLY SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS LATE THIS AFTERNOON. ALTHOUGH RAP ANALYSIS SUGGESTS THAT DEEP-LAYER SHEAR IS IN THE 20 TO 30 KT RANGE ACROSS MUCH OF THE REGION...THE LATEST WSR-88D VWP AT TUCUMCARI SHOWS 0-6 KM SHEAR OF 30-35 KT. THIS APPEARS TO BE UNDER THE STRONGEST MID-LEVEL FLOW WITH SHEAR ENHANCED BY DIRECTIONAL VEERING FROM THE SFC TO 3 KM AGL. THE MODERATE INSTABILITY AND OBSERVED WIND FIELD WOULD BE ENOUGH FOR A SEVERE THREAT AS CELLS MOVE EWD INTO THE STRONGER INSTABILITY LATE THIS AFTERNOON. ALTHOUGH SUPERCELLS ARE NOT EXPECTED TO DEVELOP...MID-LEVEL STORM ROTATION WILL BE POSSIBLE. A FEW OF THE STRONGER MULTICELLS MAY BE ACCOMPANIED BY MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE AREA IS BEING MONITORED FOR SOME INCREASE IN THE SVR RISK...WITH LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WINDS POSSIBLE. WW ISSUANCE IS POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LEADING EDGE OF REMNANT CONVECTION IS SPREADING TOWARD THE MT/ND BORDER AMIDST WEAK LARGE-SCALE ASCENT. SOME INTENSIFICATION HAS BEEN NOTED WITH A CONVECTIVE ELEMENT SHORTLY ENTERING DIVIDE COUNTY ND. WITH THE AIR MASS ACROSS WRN ND HAVING BECOME MODERATELY UNSTABLE FEATURING MLCAPE AROUND 1500-2500 J/KG...IT IS POSSIBLE FOR FURTHER DEVELOPMENT/INTENSIFICATION OF CONVECTION AS IT SPREADS EWD DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. AN ISOLATED SVR WIND/HAIL RISK MAY EXIST. HOWEVER...WITH STRONGER DEEP SHEAR DISPLACED TO THE W OF THE REGION...AND GIVEN THE OVERALL LACK OF STRONGER LARGE-SCALE ASCENT...THE SVR RISK MAY NOT INCREASE MORE SUBSTANTIALLY UNTIL ONGOING CONVECTION IN CNTRL MT SPREADS ACROSS THE REGION THIS EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED SUPERCELLS WILL CONTINUE MOVING ACROSS PORTIONS OF CNTRL/ERN MT THIS AFTERNOON. SVR HAIL...SOME POSSIBLY SIGNIFICANT /DIAMETER 2 INCHES OR GREATER/...MAY ACCOMPANY THIS ACTIVITY. A TORNADO OR TWO WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SCATTERED SUPERCELLS WILL CONTINUE SPREADING ENEWD/EWD ACROSS PORTIONS OF CNTRL MT FROM MEAGHER COUNTY TO FERGUS COUNTY...SPREADING INTO PETROLEUM COUNTY AND EVENTUALLY EWD INTO PARTS OF GARFIELD AND VALLEY COUNTIES. THE PRESENCE OF 1000-2000 J/KG OF MLCAPE WITH 50-65 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR WILL MAINTAIN SUPERCELL STRUCTURES WITH SVR HAIL -- SOME POSSIBLY SIGNIFICANT -- AND SVR WIND POTENTIAL. SFC OBSERVATIONS AT LEWISTOWN AND JORDAN INDICATE DEWPOINTS HOLDING IN THE MIDDLE/UPPER 50S WITH A NORTH WIND...IMPLYING SUPPORT OF AMPLE MOISTURE/BUOYANCY WITH AN ELONGATED HODOGRAPH. DESPITE WEAK LOW-LEVEL FLOW...HODOGRAPH CURVATURE/LONG LENGTH THROUGH A DEEP LAYER WILL SUPPORT THE RISK FOR A TORNADO OR TWO WITH THE AFOREMENTIONED CONVECTION RESIDING NEAR/N OF A QUASI-STATIONARY BOUNDARY. OTHER MORE ISOLATED SUPERCELLS NEAR/E OF HAVRE AND NEAR BOZEMAN WILL ALSO POSE A SVR RISK WHILE SPREADING EWD. ..COHEN.. 06/09/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS DEVELOPING/MOVING ACROSS THIS REGION MAY POSE AN ISOLATED SEVERE RISK THROUGH THE EVENING...WITH LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS THE MAIN THREATS. WW ISSUANCE IS UNLIKELY AT THE MOMENT DUE TO THE ISOLATED THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED CONVECTION HAS RECENTLY INITIATED OVER THE BLACK HILLS OF WRN SD...AND ADDITIONAL CONVECTION MAY DEVELOP ACROSS NERN WY INTO SERN MT OVER THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO IN ASSOCIATION WITH THE GLANCING INFLUENCE OF AN UPPER TROUGH OVER THE ERN PACIFIC. THIS ACTIVITY WILL LIE ON THE FRINGE OF STRONGER MID-LEVEL FLOW PRESENT OVER MUCH OF CNTRL INTO ERN MT. LATEST VWP FROM KUDX INDICATES A VERTICALLY VEERING WIND PROFILE THROUGH 6 KM...BUT WINDS AT/BELOW 4 KM ARE GENERALLY 15 KT OR LESS. STILL...0-6 KM SHEAR AROUND 30-35 KT SHOULD ALLOW FOR SOME STORM ORGANIZATION...MAINLY MULTICELLS POSING AN ISOLATED LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WIND RISK. SFC OBSERVATIONS ACROSS MOST OF THE MCD AREA REVEAL LIMITED LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE...WITH DEWPOINTS GENERALLY IN THE MID 40S AND LOWER 50S. STILL...WITH VERY STEEP LOW TO MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES PRESENT...MLCAPE AROUND 250-1250 J/KG WILL BE SUFFICIENT TO SUPPORT CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT. AN ARCING BAND OF BROKEN CONVECTION POSING MAINLY A LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND THREAT ACROSS N-CNTRL WY MAY MOVE INTO WRN PORTIONS OF THE MCD AREA OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS IF IT IS ABLE TO MAINTAIN ITSELF. REGARDLESS...THE LIMITED LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE AND MARGINAL SHEAR SHOULD KEEP THE SEVERE THREAT ISOLATED ACROSS THIS REGION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS THAT HAVE FORMED ACROSS THIS REGION WILL POSE A RISK FOR LARGE HAIL AND STRONG/GUSTY WINDS FOR THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS BEFORE DIMINISHING. WW ISSUANCE IS NOT EXPECTED AT THIS TIME.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WEAK LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE ALONG A SFC TROUGH ACROSS WRN KS INTO SWRN NEB HAS RESULTED IN ISOLATED CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT ACROSS THE MCD REGION OVER THE PAST HOUR OR TWO. SLY LOW-LEVEL WINDS OF 20-30 KT IN THE 0-2 KM LAYER PER KDDC VWP SHOULD SUPPORT CONTINUED DEVELOPMENT OF ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS ALONG THE SFC TROUGH. HOWEVER...WINDS DIMINISH QUICKLY ABOVE 2 KM...AND 0-6 KM SHEAR REMAINS WEAK. THIS WEAK SHEAR SHOULD LIMIT STORM LONGEVITY AND ORGANIZATION. HOWEVER...A WELL-MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER WITH STEEP LOW TO MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES IS PRESENT ACROSS WRN KS/NEB...AND MODERATE INSTABILITY COMBINED WITH THE MODESTLY ENHANCED LOW-LEVEL FLOW SHOULD ALLOW FOR ONGOING/ADDITIONAL THUNDERSTORMS TO POSE AN ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND STRONG/GUSTY WIND RISK FOR THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. THE SEVERE THREAT SHOULD QUICKLY DIMINISH WITH THE LOSS OF DAYTIME HEATING AND RESULTANT INSTABILITY AFTER SUNSET.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE THREAT SHOULD DIMINISH FROM WEST TO EAST ACROSS THE REMAINING PART OF WW 239 THROUGH THE EVENING. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR POSSIBLE DOWNSTREAM WW ISSUANCE INTO WESTERN NORTH DAKOTA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 00Z...A LONG-LIVED INTENSE SUPERCELL WAS MOVING QUICKLY EWD INTO PRAIRIE AND MCCONE COUNTIES IN MONTANA. STRONG/POTENTIALLY SEVERE TSTMS ARE ALSO ONGOING TO THE SOUTHWEST AND NORTH OF THAT CELL. THE SURFACE PATTERN IS BECOMING INCREASINGLY COMPLEX ACROSS THE AREA...WITH A WEAK COLD FRONT DRAPED ACROSS CNTRL MT/NWRN ND...OUTFLOW SURGING NWD OUT OF CONVECTION IN N-CNTRL WY...AND A WEAK SFC TROUGH IN PLACE ACROSS FAR ERN MT INTO WRN ND. STRONG SWLY MIDLEVEL FLOW WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT SUFFICIENT DEEP-LAYER SHEAR FOR ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE STRUCTURES WHERE SURFACE-BASED BUOYANCY CAN BE MAINTAINED. NEW INITIATION IS POSSIBLE ON THE VARIOUS BOUNDARIES FOR THE NEXT 1-2 HRS...SUCH AS THE RECENT DEVELOPMENT IN YELLOWSTONE COUNTY MT. SUPERCELLS WILL CONTINUE TO BE POSSIBLE FOR THE NEXT 1-2 HRS WITH AN ATTENDANT LARGE HAIL AND ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND RISK. THE LEAD SUPERCELL WILL ALSO POSE SOME RISK OF A TORNADO AS IT MOVES INTO A REGION WITH SOMEWHAT RICHER LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE ON THE COOL SIDE OF THE FRONT. WHILE ONLY A MODEST INCREASE IN THE LOW-LEVEL JET IS FORECAST THIS EVENING...SOME UPSCALE GROWTH IS POSSIBLE AS COLD POOLS CONGLOMERATE...WITH AN ATTENDANT DAMAGING WIND RISK. SOME INCREASE IN CONVECTION HAS BEEN NOTED RECENTLY ACROSS SWRN ND INTO NWRN SD...WHILE ONGOING CONVECTION IN MONTANA/WYOMING MAY BEGIN TO SPREAD INTO WRN ND/NWRN SD BY 01-02Z. DOWNSTREAM WATCH ISSUANCE INTO THESE AREAS IS POSSIBLE IF CONVECTIVE TRENDS INDICATE A THREAT OF MULTIPLE SEVERE STORMS LASTING INTO THE EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ONGOING BROKEN LINE OF THUNDERSTORMS ACROSS ERN NM AND THE WRN TX PANHANDLE WILL POSE A MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AND STRONG TO LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND THREAT FOR THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. WW ISSUANCE IS UNLIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED CONVECTION THAT DEVELOPED EARLIER THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS ERN NM ALONG A SFC TROUGH HAS CONGEALED INTO A BROKEN LINE OF THUNDERSTORMS ACROSS PARTS OF THE WRN TX PANHANDLE INTO SERN NM. WHILE NWLY MID-LEVEL FLOW IS NOT OVERLY STRONG...SOME ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH A WEAK SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER THE MCD REGION MAY AID THE CONTINUATION OF THUNDERSTORMS FOR THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. THE 00Z SOUNDING FROM AMA REVEALS A VEERING WIND PROFILE WITH HEIGHT THROUGH 5 KM...ALTHOUGH WINDS WEAKEN ABOVE THAT LEVEL THROUGH 9 KM. REGARDLESS...30-35 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR SHOULD ALLOW FOR ONGOING THUNDERSTORMS TO MAINTAIN SOME ORGANIZATION AS THEY PROPAGATE ESEWD WITH TIME. STEEP LOW TO MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES PRESENT ACROSS THE MCD AREA COMBINED WITH SUFFICIENT BUOYANCY MAY PROMOTE CONVECTIVE DOWNDRAFT WINDS THAT COULD APPROACH/EXCEED SEVERE LEVELS ON AN ISOLATED BASIS. LARGE HAIL MAY ALSO BE POSSIBLE WITH ANY STRONGER CORES EMBEDDED WITHIN THE LINE. WITH DIURNAL COOLING OCCURRING OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS...MLCIN WILL INCREASE SUBSTANTIALLY WITH EWD EXTENT ACROSS THE TX/OK PANHANDLES. THIS SHOULD TEND TO LIMIT THE SPATIAL EXTENT OF THE WIND/HAIL THREAT TO MAINLY WRN/CNTRL PORTIONS OF THE PANHANDLES AND ERN NM OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. GIVEN THE LIMITED SPATIAL/TEMPORAL SEVERE THREAT...WW ISSUANCE IS UNLIKELY AT THIS TIME.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DEVELOPING THUNDERSTORMS MAY BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING ISOLATED LARGE HAIL THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS. WW ISSUANCE IS UNLIKELY AT THIS TIME.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT VISIBLE SATELLITE AND RADAR IMAGERY INDICATE CONVECTION IS DEVELOPING ACROSS THE MCD AREA ALONG AND N OF A STALLED FRONTAL BOUNDARY MAINLY IN ASSOCIATION WITH MODESTLY STRENGTHENING SWLY WINDS ON THE NOSE OF A LOW-LEVEL JET ACROSS NEB/IA. THE 00Z SOUNDING FROM DVN SHOWS A STRONGLY VEERING WIND PROFILE IN THE 0-6 KM LAYER...WHICH IS CONTRIBUTING TO 35-40 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR ACROSS THE MCD REGION. INITIAL CONVECTIVE ACTIVITY MAY BE NEAR-SFC BASED...BUT SHOULD BECOME ELEVATED QUICKLY OVER THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO WITH THE LOSS OF DAYTIME HEATING. MODESTLY STEEP LOW TO MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES COMBINED WITH A MOIST LOW-LEVEL AIRMASS ARE CONTRIBUTING TO MUCAPE GENERALLY IN THE 500-1500 J/KG RANGE ACROSS SRN WI INTO NRN IL. THIS SUFFICIENT COMBINATION OF INSTABILITY AND SHEAR SHOULD ALLOW FOR ONGOING/ADDITIONAL CONVECTION TO DEVELOP SOME MID-LEVEL ROTATION AND POSE MAINLY AN ISOLATED LARGE HAIL RISK THROUGH THE EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE THUNDERSTORM THREAT CONTINUES ACROSS WW 239/240 AND ADJACENT AREAS. GRADUAL WEAKENING IS EXPECTED WITH TIME...BUT SOME SEVERE THREAT WILL PERSIST INTO THE LATE EVENING ALONG AND AHEAD OF EXISTING STORMS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 0320Z...A VERY LONG-LIVED SUPERCELL HAS MOVED INTO BILLINGS CO IN ND...WHILE ANOTHER INTENSE CLUSTER /ANCHORED BY ANOTHER RELATIVELY LONG-LIVED SUPERCELL/ WAS MOVING ACROSS NWRN ND AND APPROACHING THE MINOT VICINITY. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND WILL REMAIN A THREAT WITH THIS ACTIVITY...WITH RADAR SIGNATURES INDICATING A THREAT OF WIND-DRIVEN HAIL FOR AT LEAST THE SHORT TERM. ELSEWHERE...A LOOSELY ORGANIZED MCS HAS EVOLVED OVER E-CNTRL MT...WITH MORE DISORGANIZED CONVECTION EXTENDING INTO WRN ND/SD. THE SEVERE THREAT ACROSS WW 239 SHOULD BE OVER BY THE 04Z EXPIRATION TIME AS STORMS MOVE OUT OF THE AREA. AS DESTABILIZATION DUE TO NOCTURNAL COOLING BEGINS IN EARNEST...A GRADUAL WEAKENING TREND IS EXPECTED...THOUGH SOME CONVECTION IS EXPECTED TO PERSIST INTO THE LATE EVENING AS A MODESTLY INCREASING LOW-LEVEL JET INTERACTS WITH A FRONTAL BOUNDARY AND VARIOUS OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES ACROSS THE AREA. A MORE ROBUST MCS APPEARS TO BE EVOLVING ACROSS NRN ND...WHICH MAY RESULT IN A CONTINUATION OF SOME SEVERE WIND AND HAIL RISK TO THE NERN EDGE OF WW 240 AND BEYOND BY 05-06Z. LOCAL ADDITION OF COUNTIES MAY BE REQUIRED ACROSS PORTIONS OF WW 240 IN THE SHORT TERM...WHILE THE NEED FOR ANY DOWNSTREAM ISSUANCE WILL BE DETERMINED BY CONVECTIVE TRENDS IN THE NEXT 1-2 HRS. ..DEAN.. 06/10/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A DAMAGING WIND THREAT WILL CONTINUE FOR AT LEAST THE NEXT 2-3 HRS. WATCH ISSUANCE DOWNSTREAM OF WW 240 IS POSSIBLE BY 05Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SMALL BUT INTENSE MCS HAS EVOLVED ACROSS NRN ND...WITH A 67 KT WIND GUST RECENTLY NOTED AT MIB AND VERY STRONG WINDS NOTED JUST ABOVE THE SURFACE FROM THE KMBX RADAR. WHILE THE TENDENCY WILL BE FOR THIS SYSTEM TO BECOME INCREASINGLY ELEVATED WITH TIME...MODERATELY STRONG LOW-LEVEL SELY FLOW /NOTED ON KMVX VWP/ AND RELATIVELY RICH MOISTURE WILL HELP TO SUSTAIN THIS SYSTEM...WITH SOME THREAT OF DAMAGING WIND INTO THE OVERNIGHT HOURS. COUNTIES HAVE BEEN ADDED TO WW 240 TO COVER THIS THREAT IN THE SHORT TERM...BUT THIS SYSTEM IS LIKELY TO BEGIN PROGRESSING EWD OUT OF WW 240 BY 05Z...POSSIBLY NECESSITATING DOWNSTREAM WATCH ISSUANCE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR SEVERE WIND GUSTS APPEARS TO BE DIMINISHING ALONG THE INTERNATIONAL BORDER...WITH THE MAIN RISK FOR STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUSTS LIKELY CONFINED ALONG THE SOUTHERN PORTION OF WW/S 240/241.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR TRENDS SUGGEST THE LEADING EDGE OF THE QLCS NEAR THE INTERNATIONAL BORDER OVER NORTHEAST ND HAS WEAKENED IN BOTH THE LOWEST LEVEL REFLECTIVITY GRADIENT AND IN CONSTANT ALTITUDE REFLECTIVITY AT 5-9 KM MSL. WHILE THE ROLLA AWOS MEASURED A SEVERE WIND GUST OF 52 KT AT 0535Z...DOWNSTREAM WIND GUSTS SHOULD BE WEAKER WITH THIS PORTION OF THE QLCS. THE PRIMARY SHORT-TERM SEVERE THREAT SHOULD EXIST OVER EAST-CENTRAL ND WITH THE TRAILING NORTH/SOUTH-ORIENTED QLCS FROM PIERCE TO KIDDER COUNTIES AS OF 0605Z. CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW FROM THE LEAD QLCS HAS SLOWED ITS FORWARD MOTION ACROSS BENSON AND WELLS COUNTIES. PARTS OF THE LATTER QLCS WILL OVERTAKE THIS BOUNDARY AND THIS MAY INCREASE THE LIKELIHOOD FOR A BOWING STRUCTURE TO DEVELOP AND/OR ACCELERATE FROM CURRENT EASTWARD MOVEMENT AROUND 40 KT. ..GRAMS.. 06/10/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUSTS MAY PERSIST THROUGH ABOUT 10Z WITHIN AN INCREASINGLY CONFINED SWATH OF NORTHEAST ND TO A TIER OF NORTHWEST MN COUNTIES. A MUCH MORE STABLE/DRIER AIR MASS TO THE EAST IN NORTHERN MN SHOULD YIELD A SUBSTANTIALLY WEAKENING RISK TOWARDS SUNRISE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUSTS CONTINUE ALONG THE PORTION OF THE QLCS /CENTERED ON NELSON COUNTY ND AS OF 0750Z/ THAT ACCELERATED IN FORWARD SPEED TO 45-50 KT. CURRENT EXTRAPOLATION SUGGESTS THIS WILL REACH THE GRAND FORKS AREA IN THE NEXT HOUR. EAST OF THE RED RIVER VALLEY...A ROBUST SURFACE DEW POINT GRADIENT EXISTS ACROSS NORTHERN MN WITHIN A PERSISTENT SURFACE RIDGE EMANATING FROM AN ANTICYCLONE OVER EASTERN ONTARIO. EXPECTATION IS FOR THE QLCS TO WEAKEN SIGNIFICANTLY AS IT ENCOUNTERS THIS INCREASINGLY STABLE AIR MASS TO THE EAST. AS SUCH...A NEW WW ISSUANCE IS NOT ANTICIPATED. ..GRAMS.. 06/10/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
